purpose.primary: Provide a small formal teaching abstraction for selected structural properties associated with the Unified Resonance Theorem.
purpose.formal_goal: Expose the algebraic structure and assumptions required to reason formally about a three-factor composition.
purpose.educational_principle: Compact mathematical notation can hide type, operation, identity, and associativity assumptions that formalization must make explicit.

source_factors.role: symbolic overlay from a dimensional layer

source_alignment.formal_abstraction: Local multiplicative teaching algebra with explicit identity and associativity laws.

hidden_questions: Do all three factors inhabit the same carrier type?
Does the operation have an identity?
Which algebraic properties are actually needed by the intended theorem?
formalization_problem.principle: Familiar notation should not be allowed to silently answer these questions.

why_local_algebra.purpose: Make the assumptions needed for selected composition proofs explicit without claiming a complete canonical algebra for the source theorem.
why_local_algebra.boundary: The local teaching algebra is introduced by the formalization and must not be retroactively attributed to the source unless the source independently supplies those laws.

composition.formal_question: How is an unparenthesized three-factor composition interpreted?
composition.lesson: Parenthesization becomes formally irrelevant only when an appropriate associativity law is available.

associativity.formal_role: Permit regrouping of a three-factor composition without changing the represented result.

example_invalid_upgrade.unsupported_conclusion: Q * F * S = F * Q * S

commutativity_boundary.principle: Do not use an algebraic law that the formal model has not supplied.

identity.formal_role: Represent a neutral factor for composition.
identity.teaching_question: What happens if one represented factor is replaced by the identity?
identity.interpretation_boundary: The formal identity is an algebraic element. Its meaning for any source-domain factor requires a separate interpretation.

three_factor_result.conceptual_definition: compose Q, F, and S using the supplied multiplication operation

formal_targets.name: Three-Factor Reassociation
formal_targets.claim: The represented three-factor composition may be regrouped under the supplied associativity law.

formal_targets.name: Left Identity
formal_targets.claim: The supplied identity acts neutrally on the left.

formal_targets.name: Right Identity
formal_targets.claim: The supplied identity acts neutrally on the right.

formal_targets.name: Identity Factor Reduction
formal_targets.claim: A represented identity factor can be removed according to the supplied identity laws.

non_targets: physical meaning of the local multiplication operation
proof that Q_z, F_theta, and S_dim naturally share one carrier type
proof that source-domain composition is associative
proof that source-domain composition has an identity
proof that factor order is irrelevant
complete formalization of the Unified Resonance source

awareness.question: What factors, types, operations, and laws are actually present?
awareness.formal_answer: Three represented factors plus an explicitly supplied local composition structure.

alignment.question: What corresponds?
alignment.formal_answer: Q_z, F_theta, and S_dim are mapped to three factors in the local teaching algebra.

coherence.question: Does this hold together?
coherence.formal_answer: Selected composition properties follow only under the explicitly supplied algebraic laws.

clarity.question: Can this be understood and inspected?
clarity.formal_answer: The teaching algebra makes previously implicit type and algebraic assumptions visible.

continuity.question: What persists through change?
continuity.formal_answer: Selected composition relationships persist under reassociation and identity insertion or removal when the corresponding laws hold.

formal_awareness.principle: Read the algebra before manipulating the expression.

strong_inside_model: source first factor <-> formal first factor
source second factor <-> formal second factor
source third factor <-> formal third factor
unresolved_source_relationships: whether the factors naturally inhabit one empirical carrier
whether multiplication is the correct source-domain composition
whether the supplied identity has source-domain meaning
formal_alignment.principle: The formal mapping is useful but partial.

questions: Does identity removal follow from the supplied identity laws?
Is any proof silently using commutativity?
Are all required operations defined on the represented carrier?
formal_coherence.scope: Internal behavior of the local teaching algebra.

formal_clarity.principle: Formalization clarifies precisely which rules permit each transformation.

preserved_under_identity: represented result under the supplied identity law
formal_continuity.principle: Continuity can concern invariance under permitted structural transformations.

not_assumed: complete equivalence between source notation and local algebra
assumptions.principle: The assumptions introduced for the teaching formalization remain part of the theorem context.

minimal_assumption_strategy.principle: Add only the algebraic laws required for the teaching results being investigated.
minimal_assumption_strategy.avoid: Import a much stronger algebraic structure merely because it makes theorem proving more convenient.
minimal_assumption_strategy.benefit: Makes the dependency of each theorem easier to inspect.

stronger_structure_warning.example: Replacing the local teaching algebra with a commutative group or ring.
stronger_structure_warning.risk: The stronger structure may silently permit transformations never justified by the source.
stronger_structure_warning.question: Which theorem actually requires this stronger assumption?

verified_consequences.scope: Selected algebraic consequences represented in the compiler-checked Lean teaching artifact.
include: selected consequences of the local ResonanceAlgebra structure
conditional_on: the theorem statements in the canonical Lean source

lean_establishes: selected theorems under the explicitly supplied local algebraic structure
lean_does_not_establish: the Unified Resonance source is empirically correct
Q_z, F_theta, and S_dim naturally inhabit the same real-world algebra
the source multiplication symbol necessarily denotes the formal multiplication used here
the source-domain composition has an identity
the teaching algebra is the unique correct formalization
the complete Unified Resonance source has been formally verified
formalization_boundary.principle: The proof verifies consequences of the supplied algebra, not the independent correctness of choosing that algebra.

model_choice_boundary.question: Why this algebra?
model_choice_boundary.principle: Formal proof checks consequences after the modeling choice. It does not automatically validate the modeling choice.

source_vs_formal_model.source: Three named factors combined using compact multiplication notation.
source_vs_formal_model.formal_model: Generic carrier with explicit multiplication, identity, and associativity laws.
source_vs_formal_model.relationship_type: teaching algebra introduced to expose required structure

student_questions: What type are the three factors in this formalization?

What does the identity element do?
Which algebraic laws came from the teaching model rather than directly from the source?

student_exercise.instruction: Identify the minimum algebraic property required for each transformation.

variation_exercises.question: Can the three factors still be freely regrouped?
Which new reorderings become provable, and did the source justify that stronger assumption?
Can the new expression be shown equal using only associativity?
What remains after simplification under the supplied identity laws?

questions: Which two differ only by grouping?
Which law would be required for each equality?
associativity_vs_commutativity_exercise.purpose: Prevent accidental use of a law that was never supplied.

claim_strength.supported: Selected structural consequences under an explicit local algebra.
claim_strength.unsupported_upgrade: Therefore the Unified Resonance source factors empirically form this algebra.
claim_strength.principle: The theorem should remain no stronger than the supplied formal structure supports.

possible_questions: Should Q_z, F_theta, and S_dim have distinct types?

future_formalization.rule: Do not strengthen the algebra before identifying which source or modeling requirement justifies the additional structure.

typed_factor_extension.future_possible_model: heterogeneous factor types with explicit composition maps
typed_factor_extension.reason_to_consider: The source factors have distinct conceptual roles.
typed_factor_extension.current_artifact_claim: No heterogeneous formalization is represented here.

compiler_validation.meaning: The human-source formal artifact was accepted under the stated Lean environment.
compiler_validation.boundary: Compiler acceptance applies to the represented local algebraic teaching artifact and does not establish the broader Unified Resonance interpretation.

lean_source_contract.if_embedded: Copy the compiler-checked Lean source exactly rather than reconstructing it from this JSON abstraction.
lean_source_contract.reason: The AI Edition description should not create a competing version of the canonical Lean source.
